name: Digilent Basys 3

switch.note: 16 slide switches, 1 = up. Synchronise before use.

button.note: Centre, up, left, right, down. Read 1 when pressed. Debounce.

seg.note: Cathodes CA..CG (seg[0]=A ... seg[6]=G), shared by all digits. 0 lights a segment.

digit.note: Digit enables AN0-AN3 (an[0] = rightmost), 0 enables. Multiplex at about 1 kHz per digit.

uart_tx.note: FPGA transmit -> USB-UART bridge -> PC. Idle high.

uart_rx.note: PC -> USB-UART bridge -> FPGA receive. Asynchronous: synchronise.

vga.note: 12-bit VGA. 640x480@60 needs a 25 MHz pixel enable (100 MHz / 4).

notes: The 7-segment display is common-anode with inverted (active-low) anode drivers: both segments and digit enables are active-low.
Flash part per the Basys 3 reference manual (32 Mbit). The flash flow is untested on this board; check the part in Vivado's Hardware Manager if programming fails.
